statement.label: LOC-002 Name
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: Name of the location as used by humans

**Variabiliteit**: (string)

**Aanwezigheid**: 0..1

statement.label: LOC-003 Description
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: Additional details about the location that could be displayed as further information to identify the location beyond its name

**Variabiliteit**: (string)

**Aanwezigheid**: 0..1

statement.label: LOC-004 Type
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: Type of function performed at the location

**Variabiliteit**: (code)
Binding Description: (preferred): HL7 ServiceDeliveryLocationRoleType

**Aanwezigheid**: 0..*

statement.label: LOC-006 ManagingOrganization
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: Organization responsible for provisioning and upkeep of the location

**Variabiliteit**: (ref. GBB-Organization)

**Aanwezigheid**: 0..1

statement.label: LOC-007 PartOf
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: Another location of which this location is physically a part of

**Variabiliteit**: (ref. GBB-Location)

**Aanwezigheid**: 0..1  If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources. e.g., a department in a hospital cannot be the target of another Location.partOf
